caption: The drawing depicts a single brass-colored candlestick standing vertically in the center of the composition. The base of the candlestick is wide, circular, and tiered, transitioning into a tall, cylindrical shaft that has a slightly wider ring near the bottom and a narrower ring closer to the top. The candlestick is topped with a round, flat holder that supports a partially melted white candle with a visible black wick. Surrounding the candle is a circular, metallic or reflective shield, which appears to be open at the front and curved around the back and sides, with three outward-folded flaps at its top. The background is plain and off-white, and the entire image is framed with a thin, hand-drawn line parallel to the paper’s edges. The drawing uses shades of yellow, green, gray, and white, with subtle shading and highlights to suggest volume and texture.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
